analyst_feedback_summary: For the next round, propose a small set of SEIRS templates centered on fractional SEIRS with observation_map=delayed_I and delay_weeks=2 as the baseline. Explore only minimal, controlled variations: (a) delay_weeks in {2} as primary, optionally {1,3} as bracketing tests; (b) keep fractional=True for most proposals, with at most one fractional=False ablation using the same delayed_I and delay=2 to isolate impact. Do not prioritize SEIHR/H or I+H mappings given their weaker rolling/validation behavior and added complexity for this hospitalization-rate series.

Focus proposals on SEIRS with observation_map=delayed_I and delay_weeks in {1,2,3}, centered on 2. Submit matched pairs (fractional on/off) for each delay so we can attribute differences to memory vs timing. Avoid additional complexity (extra lags, extra observation transforms, or new structures). If including observation_map=I, only do so as a minimal baseline comparator with the same fractional toggle and no delay.
